audit_items.proof_trace: Two complementary guards enforce mutual exclusion: `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) aborts if a debt entry for CoinType already exists, and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) aborts on the first-borrow path if the asset is already collateral. The collateral check is only in the first-borrow branch, but this is safe because a debt entry can only be created when `is_supporting_collateral == false`, and `deposit_ctoken`'s guard prevents `is_supporting_collateral` from ever becoming `true` while a debt entry exists — so the state [debt X + collateral X] is unreachable.
